prompt: Rendered as a pencil sketch with light color wash, the scene captures a quiet library reading room. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits upright on a wooden chair, her posture rigid and attentive. Beside her, to her right, rests a small terrier with floppy ears, its head tilted curiously toward the center of the room. In the center, a young man in a blue sweater leans forward over a large oak table, his elbow resting heavily on the surface as he studies a thick book. Directly across from him sits a girl with braided hair, who is pointing at a specific paragraph in the open text, drawing his attention to the page. To the right, a tall librarian in a gray cardigan stands near a rolling ladder, holding a stack of returned books tightly against her chest. Next to the librarian, a potted fern with drooping leaves adds a touch of greenery to the corner. The interaction between the girl with braided hair and the young man in the blue sweater is focal, as she gestures clearly while he looks intently at where her finger lands. Meanwhile, the elderly woman in the floral dress watches them with a gentle smile, her hands folded neatly in her lap. The small terrier remains still, observing the human exchanges with mild interest. There is no electronic device visible anywhere in the space, preserving the analog atmosphere of the setting. The lines are soft yet distinct, capturing the texture of the paper and the fabric of their clothes without heavy shading.
